name: Famien Resources Limited
summary: Famien Resources Limited is an Australian company primarily engaged in the identification, evaluation, and strategic investment in natural resource properties throughout Australia. The firm specifically targets deposits rich in gold, nickel, copper, and Platinum Group Elements (PGE). A key asset in its portfolio is the entirely owned West Yilgarn project, which encompasses a substantial area of 1,755 square kilometers within the West Yilgarn province. Established in 2012 and based in Cottesloe, Australia, the company was formerly known as Enegex Limited before officially changing its name to Famien Resources Limited in May 2026.
